headline: New Vega integration pack added; FortiGate modeling rule crash fixed
summary_md:
A quiet day: one new pack and one bug fix.

- **Vega** is a new integration pack that ingests alerts and incidents from the Vega platform, with dedicated incident/alert fields for detections, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, verdicts, and an external-IP enrichment playbook.
- **FortiGate**'s modeling rule crashed when `saddr` held an address-object name with an embedded IP (e.g. `Ransom_140.88.40.4`) instead of a bare IP, raising "is not a valid IP address" in `incidr()`. The rule now extracts the embedded IP before evaluating it.

highlights.title: New pack: Vega
highlights.detail: Ingests alerts and incidents from the Vega platform, including MITRE ATT&CK tactics/techniques, verdicts, and a generic external-IP enrichment playbook.

highlights.title: FortiGate modeling rule no longer crashes on address-object saddr values
highlights.detail: Address-object names containing an embedded IP (e.g. Ransom_140.88.40.4) previously reached incidr() unparsed and threw an error; the IP is now extracted first and still mapped.

items.Packs/Vega: New pack: ingests alerts and incidents from the Vega platform into Cortex XSOAR.
items.Packs/FortiGate: Fixed a modeling rule crash on non-standard IPv4 saddr values (address-object names with an embedded IP).
